caption:
A dark gray wolf bounds across a flat, snow-covered field under pale winter light, its body angled to the right. Sparse tufts of dead vegetation streak past in the blurred background, marking steady forward progress. Its legs cycle through a long, springing gait, alternately reaching and tucking beneath the chest, while the bushy tail streams behind and its muzzle points forward as it runs across snow.

A hard cut replaces the wolf with a large bull elk in the white expanse, facing the camera head-on. Its tan body contrasts with a dark, snow-dusted neck ruff, and broad branching antlers spread above an upraised head. The elk holds an alert posture, its legs shifting slightly and its neck angle changing as it moves. It turns its head and adjusts its stance, the antlers moving slightly as it shifts.

The wolf is no longer visible, and the elk remains in the snow, its head turning and antlers held wide as it continues to shift its weight and its stance slowly.
